chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But over those who take him as their master.

key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُمْ: Those who take him as master/ally

ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a) clarification that Satan’s authority (*sulṭān*) is conditional, applying only to those who voluntarily align with him, thereby refuting the notion of absolute predestination over the faithful. This distinction underscores the Shia doctrine of free will, emphasizing that spiritual subjugation is a result of human choice rather than divine compulsion. The narration serves as a theological foundation for understanding how believers can maintain their independence from Shaytan through conscious adherence to God.
